name: Pochinki-Saransk Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Saratov-Gorky Gas Pipeline (Pochinki-Saransk section), Pochinki-Saransk (Saratov-Gorky reconstruction)

researcher_notes: Built Gazprom trunk, never captured by GEM as its own row. Sources: (1) Gazprom news 16 Aug 2011 (Wayback): first stage of 'Pochinki-Saransk' commissioned near Blokhino, Lyambirsky district, Mordovia; 76 km, 5.4 MPa, branches off the six-line Urengoy-Pomary-Uzhgorod corridor; construction began Aug 2010; investor Gazprom, customer Gazprom Invest Yug, GC Stroygazmontazh; operated by Pochinkovskoe LPUMG of Gazprom transgaz Nizhny Novgorod; the page titles it 'first launch complex of the Pochinki-Saransk section of the Saratov-Gorky gas pipeline'. (2) Stroygazmontazh (SGM) project page (Wayback): 'reconstructed Saratov-Gorky gas pipeline, Pochinki-Saransk section', 1st and 2nd launch complexes, 206.8 km, 720 mm, 5.4 MPa, replaced the worn 1960 pipeline, customer Gazprom Tsentrremont. (3) Gazprom transgaz Nizhny Novgorod Penzenskoe LPUMG page (Wayback 2025-05): MG Pochinki-Saransk 113.539 km in that LPUMG's section, pig traps at km 113 and 201 of MG Pochinki-Saransk; Pochinkovskoe LPUMG page also lists 'Pochinki-Saransk' as a trunk in its zone. kgpes.ru completed-works list also names 'Saratov-Gorky, Pochinki-Saransk (II PK)'. Tier medium: length/diameter single-sourced (SGM); status operating inferred from operator pages 2025 listing the trunk in service. MATCH CHECK: not P2371 (Pochinki-Penza, 174 km, 720 mm, start 2011, route runs ~22 km west of Saransk to Penza): operator pages list Pochinki-Penza (113.175+0.45 km reserve thread in Penza section) and Pochinki-Saransk as separate trunks. CAVEAT for reviewer: P2371 shares 720 mm, 2011 start and the same corridor, so a partial overlap or P2371 being the second-stage Penza leg of this reconstruction cannot be ruled out; also this is a replacement of the 1960 Saratov-Gorky (P2383, 820 mm) corridor, not additional capacity on a new right-of-way. Also resolves the R5 sweep's cross_row_lead on a 2010 'Pochinki-Saransk-Penza' 194 km duplicating-line proposal: it was built (this line). Open: 206.8 km vs 113.5 km in Penza LPUMG section is unreconciled (Saransk is in Mordovia; the Penza-oblast leg implies the line continues past Saransk toward Penza), so EndLocation Saransk follows the project name only; capacity not found; no cost found. ROUTE: not researched (no official GIS found); RouteType/RouteAccuracy left blank for the routes leg; candidate corridor = old Saratov-Gorky/P2371 corridor via Torbeevo (km ~110 from Pochinki), Saransk area. energybase.ru page unreachable (bot wall), not cited.
